title: Tangent limits of minimizing currents with ∂T = 0 have n-homogeneous weights (Simon 7.3.1(2) with parent 3(vii)), from the registered siblings and the hypotheses (MON), (MB)
statement: Assume (MON) and (MB). These are, in exactly the form of their frozen Lean types, the statements of Submission.dimred_minimizing_monotonicity and Submission.dimred_blowup_limit_moving_centres, two of the three registered dependencies of the selected parent: (MON) monotonicity, existence and upper semicontinuity of densities, and density ≥ 1 on the support, for minimizing currents with ∂T = 0 in an embedded C² submanifold; (MB) subsequential weak limits of blow-ups with moving centres x_j → x ∈ U and scales → 0 exist, are minimizing in ℝ^P with ∂ = 0, and carry mass-measure convergence. Under these hypotheses: let n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and n ≥ 1, P := n + k, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let N be an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N) with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes T). Let x ∈ spt T and let λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0. Then there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) such that the blow-ups η_{x,λ_{φ(j)}#}T (blowUp T x λ_{φ(j)}) converge weakly to C in ℝ^P (ConvergesWeakly), their mass measures converge to μ_C for all integer multiplicity representations (MassMeasuresConverge), C is minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ), and the weight of every integer multiplicity representation R of C (IMRep univ n with R.Represents C) is n-homogeneous: R.measure(λA) = λⁿ·R.measure(A) for every λ > 0 and every Borel set A ⊆ ℝ^P, where λA = (x ↦ λx) '' A and λⁿ is written ENNReal.ofReal(λⁿ).
